    "# Working with DNA and RNA\n",
    "\n",
    "[![Open In Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/uw-ipd/tmol/blob/kdidi/sphinx-docs/docs/tutorial/08_nucleic_acids.ipynb)\n",
    "\n",
    "TMol represents proteins, DNA, and RNA in the same tensor-backed `PoseStack`. This tutorial uses three CIF structures: the Dickerson DNA dodecamer (1BNA), an engrailed homeodomain–DNA complex (1HDD), and the theophylline RNA aptamer complex (1EHT). It scores nucleic-acid terms, inspects DNA/RNA chi sampling, tests base substitutions at a protein–DNA recognition site, and repacks RNA bases around a fixed ligand.\n",
    "\n",
    "> **Prerequisites.** The scoring, packing, minimization, and ligand-context patterns come from tutorials 03–07. Use a Colab GPU for the packing sections; the examples remain small enough for the CPU documentation smoke test.\n",
    "\n",
    "## Goals\n",
    "\n",
    "- Load canonical DNA, RNA, and mixed protein–DNA systems from CIF.\n",
    "- Identify which weighted score terms act on each system.\n",
    "- Compare DNA anti-only and RNA anti/syn glycosidic-chi sampling.\n",
    "- Mutate a DNA base at a homeodomain interface, locally repack/minimize, and measure the hbond-term and total interface-score response.\n",
    "- Repack RNA bases around fixed theophylline while keeping the ligand coordinates fixed.\n",
    "- Distinguish TMol's current local primitives from RosettaDNA and Rosetta RNA protocols."
   ]
  },

    "\n",
    "The three structures are checked into the repository so the executed documentation never depends on a live structure download. CIF is the primary input because it preserves richer chemical and author metadata than PDB; the ligand-bearing aptamer additionally uses CIF chemical-component bonds during ligand preparation."

    "from contextlib import redirect_stderr, redirect_stdout\n",
    "from io import StringIO\n",
    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "import warnings\n",
    "\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import torch\n",
    "from IPython.display import display\n",
    "from biotite.structure.io import load_structure\n",
    "\n",
    "import tmol\n",
    "from tmol import beta2016_score_function\n",
    "from tmol.database import ParameterDatabase\n",
    "from tmol.io.pose_stack_from_biotite import pose_stack_from_biotite\n",
    "from tmol.optimization.minimizers import run_cart_min\n",
    "from tmol.pack.pack_rotamers import pack_rotamers\n",
    "from tmol.pack.packer_task import PackerPalette, PackerTask, SetPackerTask\n",
    "from tmol.pack.rotamer.build_rotamers import build_rotamers\n",
    "from tmol.pack.rotamer.dunbrack.dunbrack_chi_sampler import create_dunbrack_sampler_from_database\n",
    "from tmol.pack.rotamer.fixed_aa_chi_sampler import FixedAAChiSampler\n",
    "from tmol.pack.rotamer.include_current_sampler import IncludeCurrentSampler\n",
    "from tmol.pack.rotamer.na_chi_sampler import NaChiRotamerSampler\n",
    "from tmol.pose.pose_stack_builder import PoseStackBuilder\n",
    "from tmol.score.score_types import ScoreType\n",
    "from tmol.score.score_utils import (\n",
    "    build_sidechain_coord_mask,\n",
    "    compute_block_adjacency,\n",
    "    compute_block_centroids_and_furthest_dist,\n",
    "    res_mask_to_coord_mask,\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "SEED = 20260808\n",
    "np.random.seed(SEED)\n",
    "torch.manual_seed(SEED)\n",
    "if torch.cuda.is_available():\n",
    "    torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(SEED)\n",
    "\n",
    "device = torch.device(\"cuda\" if torch.cuda.is_available() else \"cpu\")\n",
    "param_db = ParameterDatabase.get_default()\n",
    "score_function = beta2016_score_function(device, param_db=param_db)\n",
    "repo_root = Path.cwd()\n",
    "if not (repo_root / \"tmol/tests/data/cif/1BNA.cif\").exists():\n",
    "    repo_root = Path(tmol.__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def show_table(frame):\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        from itables import show\n",
    "    except ImportError:\n",
    "        return display(frame)\n",
    "    return show(frame)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def build_pose(atom_array, *, prepare_ligands=False, return_context=False):\n",
    "    diagnostics = StringIO()\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        with redirect_stdout(diagnostics), redirect_stderr(diagnostics):\n",
    "            return pose_stack_from_biotite(\n",
    "                atom_array,\n",
    "                device,\n",
    "                param_db=param_db,\n",
    "                no_optH=True,\n",
    "                prepare_ligands=prepare_ligands,\n",
    "                return_context=return_context,\n",
    "            )\n",
    "    except Exception:\n",
    "        print(diagnostics.getvalue())\n",
    "        raise\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def block_mask_for_chains(pose, chains):\n",
    "    labels = np.asarray(pose.pdb_info.chain_labels)\n",
    "    return torch.as_tensor(np.isin(labels, list(chains)), device=pose.device)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def block_mask_for_name3(pose, names):\n",
    "    mask = torch.zeros_like(pose.block_type_ind, dtype=torch.bool)\n",
    "    for pose_index in range(pose.n_poses):\n",
    "        for block_index in range(pose.max_n_blocks):\n",
    "            if int(pose.block_type_ind64[pose_index, block_index]) < 0:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            mask[pose_index, block_index] = pose.block_type(\n",
    "                pose_index, block_index\n",
    "            ).name3 in names\n",
    "    return mask\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"device={device}; TMol={tmol.__version__}\")"
   ]

    "## Three nucleic-acid systems\n",
    "\n",
    "1BNA provides canonical B-form DNA. The 1HDD structure contains two engrailed homeodomains bound to a DNA duplex; one homeodomain uses an N-terminal arm in the minor groove and a recognition helix in the major groove. The 1EHT NMR model is a 33-nt RNA aptamer surrounding theophylline. The overview below keeps non-polymer atoms out of the first two poses and retains TEP for the ligand-aware aptamer workflow."
   ]

    "## DNA and RNA glycosidic-chi sampling\n",
    "\n",
    "`NaChiRotamerSampler` reads the same fitted means and standard deviations used by the NA torsion score. DNA receives anti glycosidic-chi modes; RNA can additionally receive a syn mode when its fitted well is sufficiently favorable. Sugar pucker is read from the input and is not changed by the current packer. The next cell samples one internal nucleotide from each system and displays the actual candidate angles."

    "from tmol.score.na_torsion.params import SYN_RANGE\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def sampled_na_chis(label, pose, block_index):\n",
    "    sampler = NaChiRotamerSampler.from_database(\n",
    "        param_db, device, chi_sample_level=1, sample_syn=True\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    task = PackerTask(pose, PackerPalette())\n",
    "    task.restrict_to_repacking()\n",
    "    enabled = torch.zeros_like(pose.block_type_ind, dtype=torch.bool)\n",
    "    enabled[:, block_index] = True\n",
    "    task.disable_packing_by_block_mask(~enabled)\n",
    "    task.add_conformer_sampler(sampler)\n",
    "    set_task = SetPackerTask.from_packer_task(task)\n",
    "    n_rots, gbt_for_rotamer, _, chis = sampler.sample_chi_for_poses(\n",
    "        pose, set_task\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    values = chis[:, 0].detach().cpu().numpy()\n",
    "    return pd.DataFrame(\n",
    "        {\n",
    "            \"polymer\": label,\n",
    "            \"block_index\": block_index,\n",
    "            \"name3\": pose.block_type(0, block_index).name3,\n",
    "            \"candidate\": np.arange(len(values)),\n",
    "            \"chi_degrees\": values,\n",
    "            \"syn_range\": (values >= SYN_RANGE[0]) & (values <= SYN_RANGE[1]),\n",
    "        }\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "rotamer_frame = pd.concat(\n",
    "    [\n",
    "        sampled_na_chis(\"DNA\", poses[\"B-form DNA — 1BNA\"], 5),\n",
    "        sampled_na_chis(\"RNA\", poses[\"RNA aptamer without ligand — 1EHT\"], 16),\n",
    "    ],\n",
    "    ignore_index=True,\n",
    ")\n",
    "show_table(rotamer_frame)\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3.8))\n",
    "for label, values in rotamer_frame.groupby(\"polymer\"):\n",
    "    ax.scatter(values[\"candidate\"], values[\"chi_degrees\"], label=label, s=55)\n",
    "ax.axhspan(SYN_RANGE[0], SYN_RANGE[1], alpha=0.12, color=\"tab:orange\", label=\"syn range\")\n",
    "ax.set(xlabel=\"candidate\", ylabel=\"glycosidic chi (degrees)\", title=\"NA chi candidates at sample level 1\")\n",
    "ax.grid(alpha=0.25)\n",
    "ax.legend()\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]

   "source": [
    "## Base substitutions at a homeodomain–DNA interface\n",
    "\n",
    "The engrailed homeodomain recognizes DNA through a minor-groove N-terminal arm and a major-groove recognition helix. Rather than hard-code a visually chosen nucleotide, this workflow finds the DNA block with the most favorable weighted protein–DNA `hbond` contribution in the deposited structure. It then evaluates the original base and the three alternative DNA identities in one batch.\n",
    "\n",
    "For every variant, TMol rebuilds the selected base with `NaChiRotamerSampler`, repacks nearby protein side chains, and Cartesian-minimizes only side-chain/base atoms in that local region. Sugar-phosphate and protein-backbone atoms remain fixed. The reported `protein_DNA_interaction` is the sum of weighted cross-interface block-pair entries. `favorable_hbond_block_pairs` counts DNA–protein residue pairs whose two-orientation weighted `hbond` contribution is below −0.1; it is deliberately not called an atom-level hydrogen-bond count because TMol does not expose that analysis as a public API."
   ]

    "homeodomain_pose = poses[\"engrailed homeodomain–DNA — 1HDD\"]\n",
    "DNA_NAMES = {\"DA\", \"DC\", \"DG\", \"DT\"}\n",
    "dna_mask = block_mask_for_name3(homeodomain_pose, DNA_NAMES)\n",
    "real_mask = homeodomain_pose.block_type_ind >= 0\n",
    "protein_mask = real_mask & ~dna_mask\n",
    "\n",
    "block_scorer = score_function.render_block_pair_scoring_module(homeodomain_pose)\n",
    "by_term = block_scorer(\n",
    "    homeodomain_pose.coords, sum_terms=False, apply_weights=True\n",
    ")\n",
    "hbond_index = score_function.all_score_types().index(ScoreType.hbond)\n",
    "hbond_matrix = by_term[hbond_index, 0]\n",
    "protein_blocks = torch.nonzero(protein_mask[0], as_tuple=False).flatten()\n",
    "dna_blocks = torch.nonzero(dna_mask[0], as_tuple=False).flatten()\n",
    "target_hbond_scores = torch.stack(\n",
    "    [\n",
    "        hbond_matrix[block_index, protein_blocks].sum()\n",
    "        + hbond_matrix[protein_blocks, block_index].sum()\n",
    "        for block_index in dna_blocks\n",
    "    ]\n",
    ")\n",
    "target_block = int(dna_blocks[torch.argmin(target_hbond_scores)].item())\n",
    "target_name3 = homeodomain_pose.block_type(0, target_block).name3\n",
    "target_chain = homeodomain_pose.pdb_info.chain_labels[0, target_block]\n",
    "target_residue = homeodomain_pose.pdb_info.residue_labels[0, target_block]\n",
    "print(\n",
    "    f\"selected DNA block {target_block}: chain {target_chain}, residue {target_residue}, \"\n",
    "    f\"{target_name3}; protein hbond contribution \"\n",
    "    f\"{float(target_hbond_scores.min().detach().cpu()):.3f}\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "centroids, radii = compute_block_centroids_and_furthest_dist(homeodomain_pose)\n",
    "adjacency = compute_block_adjacency(centroids, radii)\n",
    "local_blocks = adjacency[:, target_block].clone()\n",
    "local_blocks[:, target_block] = True\n",
    "local_protein_blocks = local_blocks & protein_mask\n",
    "show_table(\n",
    "    pd.DataFrame(\n",
    "        [\n",

    "                \"nearby_protein_blocks\": int(local_protein_blocks.sum()),\n",

    "def restrict_one_identity_per_pose(task, block_index, names):\n",
    "    keep = task.per_block_considered_block_types_is_orig.detach().clone()\n",
    "    considered = task.per_block_considered_block_types\n",
    "    for pose_index, name3 in enumerate(names):\n",
    "        considered_here = considered[pose_index, block_index].detach().cpu().tolist()\n",
    "        requested = torch.tensor(\n",
    "            [\n",
    "                index >= 0 and task.pbt.active_block_types[index].name3 == name3\n",
    "                for index in considered_here\n",
    "            ],\n",
    "            dtype=torch.bool,\n",
    "            device=task.device,\n",
    "        )\n",
    "        if not torch.any(requested):\n",
    "            raise ValueError(f\"{name3} is not available at block {block_index}\")\n",
    "        keep[pose_index, block_index] = requested\n",
    "    task.per_block_is_block_type_allowed = torch.logical_and(\n",
    "        task.per_block_is_block_type_allowed, keep\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def add_protein_and_na_samplers(task):\n",
    "    task.add_conformer_sampler(\n",
    "        create_dunbrack_sampler_from_database(param_db, device)\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    task.add_conformer_sampler(FixedAAChiSampler())\n",
    "    task.add_conformer_sampler(\n",
    "        NaChiRotamerSampler.from_database(param_db, device, chi_sample_level=1)\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    task.add_conformer_sampler(IncludeCurrentSampler())\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "variants = [target_name3] + sorted(DNA_NAMES - {target_name3})\n",
    "mutation_batch = PoseStackBuilder.from_poses(\n",
    "    [homeodomain_pose] * len(variants), device\n",
    ")\n",
    "mutation_task = PackerTask(mutation_batch, PackerPalette())\n",
    "restrict_one_identity_per_pose(mutation_task, target_block, variants)\n",
    "local_design_region = local_protein_blocks.clone()\n",
    "local_design_region[:, target_block] = True\n",
    "packing_region = local_design_region.expand(len(variants), -1).clone()\n",
    "mutation_task.disable_packing_by_block_mask(~packing_region)\n",
    "add_protein_and_na_samplers(mutation_task)\n",
    "\n",
    "torch.manual_seed(SEED)\n",
    "packed_variants = pack_rotamers(mutation_batch, score_function, mutation_task)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Minimize base/side-chain atoms only: the DNA sugar-phosphate and protein\n",
    "# backbone stay fixed in this local specificity experiment.\n",
    "target_by_pose = torch.zeros_like(packed_variants.block_type_ind, dtype=torch.bool)\n",
    "target_by_pose[:, target_block] = True\n",
    "protein_region = local_protein_blocks.expand(len(variants), -1)\n",
    "movable_blocks = target_by_pose | protein_region\n",
    "coord_mask = build_sidechain_coord_mask(packed_variants) & res_mask_to_coord_mask(\n",
    "    packed_variants, movable_blocks\n",
    ")\n",
    "refined_variants = run_cart_min(\n",
    "    packed_variants,\n",
    "    score_function,\n",
    "    coord_mask=coord_mask,\n",
    "    optimizer_kwargs={\"max_iter\": 10},\n",
    ")"
   ]

    "def protein_dna_metrics(pose, target_index):\n",
    "    dna = block_mask_for_name3(pose, DNA_NAMES)[0]\n",
    "    real = pose.block_type_ind[0] >= 0\n",
    "    protein = real & ~dna\n",
    "    scorer = score_function.render_block_pair_scoring_module(pose)\n",
    "    term_matrices = scorer(pose.coords, sum_terms=False, apply_weights=True)[:, 0]\n",
    "    hbond = term_matrices[hbond_index]\n",
    "    total = term_matrices.sum(dim=0)\n",
    "    dna_indices = torch.nonzero(dna, as_tuple=False).flatten()\n",
    "    protein_indices = torch.nonzero(protein, as_tuple=False).flatten()\n",
    "    pair_hbond = hbond[dna_indices[:, None], protein_indices[None, :]]\n",
    "    pair_hbond = pair_hbond + hbond[protein_indices[:, None], dna_indices[None, :]].T\n",
    "    cross_total = total[dna_indices[:, None], protein_indices[None, :]].sum()\n",
    "    cross_total += total[protein_indices[:, None], dna_indices[None, :]].sum()\n",
    "    target_hbond = hbond[target_index, protein_indices].sum()\n",
    "    target_hbond += hbond[protein_indices, target_index].sum()\n",
    "    whole_scorer = score_function.render_whole_pose_scoring_module(pose)\n",
    "    return {\n",
    "        \"total_score\": float(whole_scorer(pose.coords).detach().cpu()[0]),\n",
    "        \"protein_DNA_interaction\": float(cross_total.detach().cpu()),\n",
    "        \"protein_DNA_hbond\": float(pair_hbond.sum().detach().cpu()),\n",
    "        \"target_protein_hbond\": float(target_hbond.detach().cpu()),\n",
    "        \"favorable_hbond_block_pairs\": int((pair_hbond < -0.1).sum().detach().cpu()),\n",
    "    }\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "variant_poses = {}\n",
    "variant_rows = []\n",
    "for pose_index, variant in enumerate(variants):\n",
    "    variant_pose = refined_variants.split(pose_index)\n",
    "    variant_poses[variant] = variant_pose\n",
    "    variant_rows.append({\"base\": variant, **protein_dna_metrics(variant_pose, target_block)})\n",
    "\n",
    "mutation_frame = pd.DataFrame(variant_rows)\n",
    "reference = mutation_frame.loc[mutation_frame[\"base\"] == target_name3].iloc[0]\n",
    "for metric in (\n",
    "    \"total_score\",\n",
    "    \"protein_DNA_interaction\",\n",
    "    \"protein_DNA_hbond\",\n",
    "    \"target_protein_hbond\",\n",
    "):\n",
    "    mutation_frame[f\"delta_{metric}\"] = mutation_frame[metric] - reference[metric]\n",
    "mutation_frame = mutation_frame.sort_values(\"delta_target_protein_hbond\", ascending=False)\n",
    "show_table(mutation_frame)\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4))\n",
    "axes[0].bar(mutation_frame[\"base\"], mutation_frame[\"delta_target_protein_hbond\"])\n",
    "axes[0].axhline(0, color=\"black\", linewidth=0.8)\n",
    "axes[0].set(\n",
    "    xlabel=\"DNA identity\",\n",
    "    ylabel=\"change in weighted hbond term\",\n",
    "    title=\"Target base ↔ protein hbond response\",\n",
    ")\n",
    "axes[1].bar(mutation_frame[\"base\"], mutation_frame[\"delta_protein_DNA_interaction\"])\n",
    "axes[1].axhline(0, color=\"black\", linewidth=0.8)\n",
    "axes[1].set(\n",
    "    xlabel=\"DNA identity\",\n",
    "    ylabel=\"change in weighted interface score\",\n",
    "    title=\"Whole protein–DNA interface response\",\n",
    ")\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",

    "                f\"interface Δ {row['delta_protein_DNA_interaction']:+.3f}\"\n",
    "            )\n",
    "            for _, row in mutation_frame.iterrows()\n",
    "        },\n",

   "source": [
    "Positive hbond or interface deltas mean that the substituted, locally refined model is less favorable than the equivalently refined starting identity under the displayed TMol score component. The experiment makes the structural response visible and tests whether this site is sequence-sensitive under the current local protocol; it does not assume in advance that every substitution must weaken the interface.\n",
    "\n",
    "## RNA aptamer with a fixed small molecule\n",
    "\n",
    "The 1EHT CIF contains explicit TEP chemical-component bonds and hydrogens. `prepare_ligands=True` creates ligand parameters and returns the extended database in the build context. The ligand is then disabled in the `PackerTask`: only nearby RNA blocks receive NA chi candidates, and Cartesian minimization is restricted to those RNA base/proton-chi atoms. Theophylline coordinates therefore remain fixed throughout this example."

    "aptamer_array = atom_arrays[\"theophylline RNA aptamer — 1EHT\"]\n",
    "aptamer_pose, aptamer_context = build_pose(\n",
    "    aptamer_array, prepare_ligands=True, return_context=True\n",
    ")\n",
    "aptamer_sfxn = beta2016_score_function(\n",
    "    device, param_db=aptamer_context.parameter_database\n",
    ")\n",
    "ligand_mask = block_mask_for_name3(aptamer_pose, {\"TEP\"})\n",
    "rna_mask = block_mask_for_name3(aptamer_pose, {\"A\", \"C\", \"G\", \"U\"})\n",
    "if int(ligand_mask.sum()) != 1:\n",
    "    raise RuntimeError(\"Expected exactly one TEP ligand block\")\n",
    "ligand_block = int(torch.nonzero(ligand_mask[0], as_tuple=False)[0])\n",
    "\n",
    "centroids, radii = compute_block_centroids_and_furthest_dist(aptamer_pose)\n",
    "aptamer_adjacency = compute_block_adjacency(centroids, radii)\n",
    "pocket_rna = aptamer_adjacency[:, ligand_block] & rna_mask\n",
    "\n",
    "aptamer_task = PackerTask(aptamer_pose, PackerPalette())\n",
    "aptamer_task.restrict_to_repacking()\n",
    "aptamer_task.disable_packing_by_block_mask(~pocket_rna)\n",
    "aptamer_task.add_conformer_sampler(\n",
    "    NaChiRotamerSampler.from_database(\n",
    "        aptamer_context.parameter_database,\n",
    "        device,\n",
    "        chi_sample_level=1,\n",
    "        sample_syn=True,\n",
    "    )\n",
    ")\n",
    "aptamer_task.add_conformer_sampler(IncludeCurrentSampler())\n",
    "\n",
    "torch.manual_seed(SEED)\n",
    "packed_aptamer = pack_rotamers(aptamer_pose, aptamer_sfxn, aptamer_task)\n",
    "aptamer_coord_mask = build_sidechain_coord_mask(packed_aptamer) & res_mask_to_coord_mask(\n",
    "    packed_aptamer, pocket_rna\n",
    ")\n",
    "refined_aptamer = run_cart_min(\n",
    "    packed_aptamer,\n",
    "    aptamer_sfxn,\n",
    "    coord_mask=aptamer_coord_mask,\n",
    "    optimizer_kwargs={\"max_iter\": 10},\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def ligand_rna_metrics(pose):\n",
    "    ligand = block_mask_for_name3(pose, {\"TEP\"})[0]\n",
    "    rna = block_mask_for_name3(pose, {\"A\", \"C\", \"G\", \"U\"})[0]\n",
    "    scorer = aptamer_sfxn.render_block_pair_scoring_module(pose)\n",
    "    matrices = scorer(pose.coords, sum_terms=False, apply_weights=True)[:, 0]\n",
    "    hb_index = aptamer_sfxn.all_score_types().index(ScoreType.hbond)\n",
    "    ligand_indices = torch.nonzero(ligand, as_tuple=False).flatten()\n",
    "    rna_indices = torch.nonzero(rna, as_tuple=False).flatten()\n",
    "    total = matrices.sum(dim=0)\n",
    "    interaction = total[ligand_indices[:, None], rna_indices[None, :]].sum()\n",
    "    interaction += total[rna_indices[:, None], ligand_indices[None, :]].sum()\n",
    "    hbond = matrices[hb_index]\n",
    "    hbond_interaction = hbond[ligand_indices[:, None], rna_indices[None, :]].sum()\n",
    "    hbond_interaction += hbond[rna_indices[:, None], ligand_indices[None, :]].sum()\n",
    "    return float(interaction.detach().cpu()), float(hbond_interaction.detach().cpu())\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "interaction_before, hbond_before = ligand_rna_metrics(aptamer_pose)\n",
    "interaction_after, hbond_after = ligand_rna_metrics(refined_aptamer)\n",
    "ligand_coord_mask = res_mask_to_coord_mask(aptamer_pose, ligand_mask)\n",
    "ligand_coords_before = aptamer_pose.coords[ligand_coord_mask]\n",
    "ligand_coords_after = refined_aptamer.coords[ligand_coord_mask]\n",
    "ligand_motion = float(\n",
    "    torch.linalg.vector_norm(ligand_coords_after - ligand_coords_before, dim=-1)\n",
    "    .max()\n",
    "    .detach()\n",
    "    .cpu()\n",
    ")\n",
    "aptamer_frame = pd.DataFrame(\n",
    "    [\n",
    "        {\n",
    "            \"stage\": \"input\",\n",
    "            \"RNA_TEP_interaction\": interaction_before,\n",
    "            \"RNA_TEP_hbond\": hbond_before,\n",
    "            \"max_ligand_motion_A\": 0.0,\n",
    "        },\n",
    "        {\n",
    "            \"stage\": \"RNA repacked + minimized; TEP fixed\",\n",
    "            \"RNA_TEP_interaction\": interaction_after,\n",
    "            \"RNA_TEP_hbond\": hbond_after,\n",
    "            \"max_ligand_motion_A\": ligand_motion,\n",
    "        },\n",
    "    ]\n",
    ")\n",
    "show_table(aptamer_frame)\n",
    "display(\n",
    "    tmol.switchable_view(\n",
    "        {\"input aptamer\": aptamer_pose, \"refined RNA pocket\": refined_aptamer},\n",
    "        notes={\n",
    "            \"input aptamer\": f\"RNA–TEP interaction {interaction_before:.3f}\",\n",
    "            \"refined RNA pocket\": (\n",
    "                f\"RNA–TEP interaction {interaction_after:.3f}; \"\n",
    "                f\"max ligand motion {ligand_motion:.6f} Å\"\n",
    "            ),\n",
    "        },\n",
    "    )\n",
    ")"

    "## Rosetta and PyRosetta comparison\n",
    "\n",
    "Rosetta has protocol layers beyond the primitives demonstrated here: RosettaDNA base-pair mutation/design machinery, specialized RNA score functions and fragment assembly, FARFAR/FARFAR2, stepwise modeling, RNA threading, and docking. TMol currently provides canonical DNA/RNA chemistry, the combined NA torsion model, NA chi rotamers, all-atom scoring, packing, and generic Cartesian/kinematic minimization in a batched PyTorch representation.\n",
    "\n",
    "Two implementation details matter when translating a Rosetta workflow:\n",
    "\n",
    "- The TMol NA packer changes glycosidic chi and sampled hydroxyl proton chis. It reads sugar pucker from the input rather than sampling pucker, so it is not a complete nucleotide conformational search.\n",
    "- The protein–DNA and aptamer examples above are local fixed-backbone/base refinements. They do not invoke RosettaDNA specificity optimization, RNA fragment assembly, docking, or ligand-pose sampling.\n",
    "\n",
    "The closest PyRosetta starting point is [14.00 RNA Basics](https://nbviewer.org/github/RosettaCommons/PyRosetta.notebooks/blob/master/notebooks/14.00-RNA-Basics.ipynb). For broader Rosetta scoring context, the [Rosetta scoring tutorial](https://docs.rosettacommons.org/demos/latest/tutorials/scoring/scoring) and [Rosetta Energy Function workshop slides](https://meilerlab.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Rosetta_Energy_Function.pdf) explain the weighted-term model and Rosetta's specialized score-function families.\n",
    "\n",
    "## Exercises\n",
    "\n",
    "1. Change the homeodomain target from the strongest hbond-scored nucleotide to the next-ranked site and compare the substitution profile.\n",
    "2. Expand `chi_sample_level` and report candidate count, runtime, and interface-score spread.\n",
    "3. Keep the DNA base fixed and repack only nearby protein side chains to separate sequence and conformational effects.\n",
    "4. In the aptamer, vary the RNA-pocket definition while asserting that TEP coordinates remain unchanged.\n",
    "5. Batch multiple starting models from the 1EHT NMR ensemble and compare pocket responses across conformers.\n",
    "\n",
    "## References\n",
    "\n",
    "- Kissinger et al., [Crystal structure of an engrailed homeodomain–DNA complex](https://doi.org/10.1016/0092-8674(90)90453-L)\n",
    "- Zimmermann et al., [Interlocking structural motifs mediate molecular discrimination by a theophylline-binding RNA](https://doi.org/10.1038/nsb0897-644)\n",
    "- [RCSB 1HDD](https://www.rcsb.org/structure/1HDD) and [RCSB 1EHT](https://www.rcsb.org/structure/1EHT)\n",
    "- [PyRosetta RNA Basics](https://nbviewer.org/github/RosettaCommons/PyRosetta.notebooks/blob/master/notebooks/14.00-RNA-Basics.ipynb)\n",
    "- [Rosetta additional energy terms, including DNA/RNA terms](https://docs.rosettacommons.org/docs/latest/rosetta_basics/scoring/score-types-additional)"
